title: Test commit_bead_state: config loader, storage guard, onboarding, and upgrade
description: Write tests in the appropriate existing test files: (1) Config loader (tests/test_config_wiring_phase3.py or equivalent) — default_config().common.commit_bead_state == True; YAML override to false is honored; make_services() produces storage with commit_bead_state matching config (assert via storage.commit_bead_state property); (2) Storage (tests/test_orchestrator.py or tests/test_storage*.py) — commit_bead_state=False: git rev-list --count HEAD unchanged after save_bead; commit_bead_state=True: new [bead] commit appears; no-kwarg constructor preserves _auto_commit=False path; (3) Onboarding (nearest existing onboarding test) — scaffold_project() writes .takt/beads/ in .gitignore and commit_bead_state: false in .takt/config.yaml; (4) Upgrade — upgrading a fixture repo without the key leaves config and .gitignore untouched; loading that config resolves commit_bead_state to True.
acceptance_criteria: YAML with commit_bead_state: false loads to False
make_services() storage instance has commit_bead_state matching config
commit_bead_state=False: git rev-list count unchanged after save_bead
Upgrade path does not mutate config or .gitignore
Post-upgrade config without key resolves commit_bead_state to True
uv run pytest tests/ -n auto -q passes
conflict_risks:
None — only config.py was touched and no sibling beads claim it.
None — only scaffold.py modified; no overlap with other in-progress beads expected.
